history.text: We have duplicate settlement rows showing up for Orchard Credit after the acquirer re-sent files last week. Find out why and fix it. Constraint: do not touch or lock ledger_entries, it is the audited table. Keep it behind a customer flag.

Found it. The batch idempotency key is the file's SHA-256, so a re-sent file with one reordered line gets a new key and creates a second batch. The retry worker has a second path to the same bug: if the first attempt times out after commit, it creates another batch. Plan: derive the key from tenant, acquirer batch ref, value date and currency, store it in a new table, and make the retry worker read it first. No change to ledger_entries.
Good. Code freeze is Thursday 18:00 so I want this in a PR before then. Also Tomas will ask about the nightly close job locks, make sure you have an answer.

Understood. PR before the freeze, and I will check the close job's locks. Starting the implementation now, then the full test suite, and I will also measure how many old duplicates exist in production, read-only.
Yes measure it read only. And the staging latency alert from Tuesday, after the PR, look into whether it's us.
Will do, after the PR is up. I will also compare the vendor gateway candidates you forwarded once those two are done.
